businessModel: Free; supports Jio’s app ecosystem and services, with ads and regional content
updateCadence: Major update in October 2026 (8.0.0 on Oct 16, 8.0.1 on Oct 30)
summary: JioSphere is Reliance Jio’s Chromium-based browser, formerly JioPages. It focuses on Indian languages and bundles a free VPN, tracker and ad blocking, a download manager and a generative AI assistant.
bestFor: Indian users who want regional-language content
People who want a free built-in VPN
notFor: People who want independent privacy auditing

pros.title: Regional languages
pros.detail: Supports 21+ regional languages with regional news and voice search.

pros.title: Free built-in VPN
pros.detail: A free VPN is included, according to its listing.

pros.title: Tracker and ad blocking
pros.detail: Anti-tracking and an ad blocker are built in.

pros.title: Chromium engine
pros.detail: Version 8.0.1 moved to the latest Chromium engine.

cons.title: Runs under Jio’s privacy policy
cons.detail: Blocking applies to third parties, but browsing remains governed by Reliance Jio’s own policy.

cons.title: No independent audit
cons.detail: No published independent security or privacy audit.

cons.title: Niche reach
cons.detail: About 0.02% of India’s browser share, grouped under “Other” by Statcounter.

faq.q: Is JioSphere the same as JioPages?

faq.a: Google Play lists more than 10 million installs.
APKPure’s listing says it has a generative AI assistant for summaries and quick answers; this is not confirmed on the Play listing.
